description:
The Army Contracting Command - Detroit Arsenal (ACC-DTA) is seeking to gain knowledge of interest, capabilities, and qualifications of various members of the community, to include both small and large businesses, for production of the item identified below.

Sample Canister, 400

NSN: 6665-01-546-4513

Part Number: 5-15-30819

FAT: Required unless waived

Responses to this survey will assist ACC-DTA in planning for a potential contract. Interested vendors are encouraged to complete the survey located under "Attachments/Links" and then return it via e-mail to:

Danielle Campbell

Contract Specialist, ACC-DTA

Email: danielle.r.campbell9.civ@army.mil

Subject Line: Market Survey - Sample Canister

You may respond in total, or in part, to the survey. However, all responses must be received no later than 07 April 2026 at 12:00 PM Local Warren, MI Time.

PLEASE NOTE: The associated Technical Data Package (TDP) will only be made available to vendors if/when a solicitation is released.
